Package org.osgi.test.cases.zigbee

Class ZCLDataTypesTestCase

java.lang.Object
junit.framework.Assert
junit.framework.TestCase
org.osgi.test.support.OSGiTestCase
org.osgi.test.support.compatibility.DefaultTestBundleControl
org.osgi.test.cases.zigbee.ZCLDataTypesTestCase
All Implemented Interfaces:
junit.framework.Test
public class ZCLDataTypesTestCase extends org.osgi.test.support.compatibility.DefaultTestBundleControl
Partial test of the ZCL data types classes. The tests verify for each ZigBeeDataType class if;
  • The data type returned by the getJavaDataType(), isAnalog(), getId() and getName() methods return the right value for that type.
  • The serialize() method throws an NullPointerException if the passed ZigBeeDataOutput is null.
  • The serialize() method throws an IllegalArgumentException if passing null value for data types that do not support an Invalid Value.
  • The serialize() method throws an IllegalArgumentException if passing a value that is instance of a class that is not compatible with the data type.
  • The serialize() method writes the right amount of bytes on in the ZigBeeDataOutput stream, and in the correct order (it checks also that the byte that are written are correct).
  • The serialize() method throws an NullPointerException if the passed ZigBeeDataInput is null.
  • The deserialize() method returns a value of the correct java class.
  • The value returned by the deserialize() is identical to the value that was previously serialized().
